title: Mount Zeil as an alien port of entry to Earth
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Mount Zeil as an alien port of entry to Earth, about unspecified at Mount Zeil, northern Australia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Mount Zeal is sort of a port of entry to the earth that friendly ones go there

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says that Mount Zeil, a mountain in Australia, is a kind of port of entry to Earth, a place where friendly beings from elsewhere arrive. He links the idea to another man, Pat Price. If true, it would mean visitors who are not human have a regular doorway onto our planet.
